Class AddressUtils

public inherited sharing class AddressUtils

Utility class for parsing and formatting addresses in Salesforce. Uses the Gemini API to parse unstructured address strings into structured Address objects, and provides a format method to build multi-line address strings from individual components.

Methods

public static String format(
  String street,
  String city,
  String state,
  String postalCode,
  String country
)

Formats address components into a multi-line string. The first line contains the street, the second line contains city, state, and postal code, and the third line contains the country. Blank components are omitted.

Parameters:
    street – Street address
    city – City name
    state – State or province
    postalCode – Postal or zip code
    country – Country name

Returns:
    String: Formatted multi-line address, or empty string if all components are blank.

Since:
    03/24/2026

public static Address parseAddress(String addressAsString)

Parses an address string into an Address object using the Gemini API.

Parameters:
    addressAsString – The address string to be parsed.

Returns:
    Address: The parsed address, or null if parsing fails.
